svg.title: Schumann resonance spectrogram
svg.desc: Published SOUSY Arctic station spectrogram, 4 December 2020, 00:00 to 15:37:51 UTC. Two measured magnetic channels, NS and EW, 0 to 30 Hz. Source log-scale PSD and colour bars are unchanged. Archived observation; dark frame and margin typography adapted by XGCS.
